en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small mill settlement in a wooded valley. Several traditional European houses and mill buildings stand close together beside a rocky stream, with forested hills rising steeply behind them. The scene is quiet and rural. At the top in red Gothic-style print is a title identifying the location; smaller printer information appears vertically along the right edge.
